questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: The ego works purely on instinct with no regard for reality

block.label: Swipe Sort
block.sub: Flick each card up into its bucket

questions.why: False — that describes the id. The ego operates on the reality principle, balancing desires against consequences.

questions.subject: D&T
questions.prompt: A designer writes an action plan mainly to keep the client informed of progress

block.label: Swipe Sort
block.sub: Flick each card up into its bucket

questions.why: True — action plans set out steps and timings so the client can see how the project will unfold and stay in the loop.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 17 cm and a height of 8 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height: ½ × 17 × 8 = 68 cm². Halving is the step rushing skips.

questions.subject: Commerce
questions.prompt: Which business plan section lists the founder's skills and past work experience?
questions.why: The management team section covers the founder's skills and experience. The executive summary just overviews the plan, market analysis covers customers and competitors, and the financial plan covers costs and revenue.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Freud's model, which part is guided by moral rules learned from parents?
questions.why: The superego holds the moral rules and conscience taught by parents and society. The id is instinctive desire, and the ego balances that desire against reality.

questions.subject: D&T
questions.prompt: A market stall keeps the same logo and colours on every product for a year. What is this mainly building?
questions.why: Consistent logo and colours build brand identity, making the stall recognisable. This isn't a financial plan, market analysis, or SWOT, which cover different parts of a business plan.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed, closed container, what happens to total mass after a chemical reaction?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system — atoms are rearranged into new products but none are lost or gained.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: Name one sign that shows a chemical reaction has taken place.
questions.why: Signs like gas bubbles, a colour change, a temperature change, or a precipitate show a new substance has formed, meaning a chemical reaction occurred.
